title: Schema for the additional measures of the Risikoanalyse (A.5)

massnahmen.description: Every additional security measure the Risikoanalyse defines for the treatment of a risk. Empty when the document defines none.

bezeichnung.description: The measure as the document names it.

zielobjekt.description: Kürzel or name of the Zielobjekt the measure applies to, as written in the document.

anforderung_id.description: The IT-Grundschutz-Kompendium requirement ID (e.g. 'SYS.1.1.A30') when the measure is a Kompendium requirement, typically one for erhöhter Schutzbedarf; empty string otherwise.

fundstelle.description: Where the measure is stated: section, table or page of the Risikoanalyse.

umsetzungsstatus_laut_dokument.description: The implementation status the Risikoanalyse itself states for the measure, verbatim; empty string when it states none.
